capabilities: Toggle whole-word matching in global search
Toggle regular-expression matching in global search
Filter search results with Files to include/exclude inputs
Match include/exclude values by file, folder, or glob pattern
extras: README includes a privacy section: the plugin reads vault file paths and contents locally, makes no network requests, collects no telemetry, and never modifies notes.
intentEvidence: Advanced search extends Obsidian's built-in Search view by adding VS Code-like search controls
problem: Obsidian's global search lacks whole-word matching, regex toggles, and path-based include/exclude filtering for precise queries.
summary: Search extension that adds whole-word and regex toggles plus file include/exclude filters to Obsidian's built-in Search view.
